name: riemann-cli
description: riemann-cli — Riemann event system CLI. Send events, query streams, manage Riemann monitoring from command line.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/riemann/riemann-cli/releases/latest/download/riemann-cli-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf riemann-cli-linux-amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv riemann-cli /usr/local/bin/ && rm riemann-cli-linux-amd64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
